description: Write a script that lists large files

steps.send: Write big.sh, an executable shell script: `./big.sh DIR` prints every file under DIR (recursively) larger than 1000 bytes, largest first, one per line as `SIZE PATH` with PATH as found from DIR (for example `1500 data/a.txt`).

graders.run: mkdir -p other && head -c 2000 /dev/zero > other/z && head -c 5 /dev/zero > other/y && sh big.sh other | diff - expected2.txt
graders.name: other dir
